description: Figure 3(a) is a line plot that illustrates the Bit-per-Character (BPC) on the validation dataset during the training phase for the SMoE routing policy. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps (x10³)", represents the number of training steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "BPC", represents the Bit-per-Character metric, also on a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot displays two lines: a black line for "SMoE Validating" and a magenta line for "SimSMoE Validating". Both lines start at a BPC of approximately 2.1 at 0 training steps. As the number of training steps increases, both lines show a rapid decrease in BPC, with the magenta line (SimSMoE) consistently maintaining a lower BPC than the black line (SMoE). By approximately 20,000 training steps, both lines converge to a BPC of approximately 1.2 and remain relatively flat for the remainder of the training.
